# ANALYSIS: J-ANCHOR-STAGE1-BACKTEST

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Validate that the base engine (as represented by the leaderboard's STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND baseline) achieves edge_capture ≥ 771 on J anchor days, then confirm with OOS walk-forward and real-fills on top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04). This ensures the engine meets OP-16 minimum edge before further optimization.

## Mechanism

Run Stage-1 backtest over full cached history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) using base engine parameters (as in leaderboard, pre-STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND). Compute engine P&L per J day, then edge_capture = sum(winners P&L) - sum(max(0, losers P&L)). If edge_capture ≥ 771, proceed to OOS walk-forward (80/20 time split) and real-fills check on top 3 J days using realistic OPRA simulator (cached bid/ask, slippage model).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Base engine parameters assume Safe account tier ($2K Safe-2 + ~$1.65K Bold-2 effective). Position sizing follows risk-rules.md: min 3 contracts, scale-up at equity thresholds. $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** Full cached history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18, ~16 months). Selection: all available data. Overfit risk: low for pure measurement (no optimization), but Stage-1 backtest may suffer from look-ahead bias if simulator not bar-exact.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (realistic OPRA check on top 3 J days not yet performed).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: max single-day loss; max drawdown: peak-to-trough equity drop; blow-up scenario: consecutive losses exceeding daily loss kill switch.
6. **Concentration:** NEEDS-CONCENTRATION (top-5 days % of P&L not yet measured).
